content_blocks.label: clause_1._REASON_FOR_NOTICE
content_blocks.text: This Notice is given pursuant to the Lease Agreement dated March 15, 2024.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_DATE_OF_EVICTION
content_blocks.text: The Tenant shall vacate the premises located at 123 Maple Street, Oakwood, State of Novaria, by 11:59 PM on April 30, 2024.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._RETURN_OF_PROPERTY
content_blocks.text: The Tenant shall return all keys and other property belonging to the Landlord upon vacating the premises.
